strings.agent.settings.title: Agent & LLM
strings.agent.settings.description: Turn the local assistant on or off and pick which intents it may run. Cloud LLM tool-calling comes later.
strings.agent.settings.enabledHint: Shows Agent in the rail and command palette. Off hides the desk completely.
strings.agent.settings.capabilitiesHint: {enabled} of {total} intents enabled — open to toggle each one
strings.agent.settings.apiKeyHint: Stored on this device for a future LLM backend. Not used yet.
strings.agent.disabled.title: Agent is off
strings.agent.disabled.description: Enable the in-app assistant in Settings → Agent / LLM, or during first-run setup.
strings.agent.capability.import_curlHint: Paste curl → open a request tab
strings.agent.capability.memoryHint: Remember / recall / forget facts in the workspace
strings.agent.capability.memory_ragHint: Search request history + facts via hashed n-gram TF-IDF
strings.agent.memory.title: Memory
strings.agent.memory.description: Workspace facts sync via memory/facts.yaml. Local facts stay on this device.
strings.agent.memory.none: No workspace attached or memory is empty.
strings.agent.rag.title: RAG index
strings.agent.rag.description: Lightweight embeddings over request history and facts — no PyTorch. Supports method:/status:/env: filters.
strings.agent.rag.none: No workspace attached or RAG index is empty.
strings.agent.settings.languageHint: UI language follows the app locale — use Languages on the rail or Settings → Appearance.
strings.agent.md.helpIntro: I understand these intents (local, no LLM yet):
strings.agent.md.helpOff: The in-app agent is **turned off**. Enable it in **Settings → Agent / LLM**.
strings.agent.md.helpNone: The agent is on, but every capability is disabled. Expand capabilities in **Settings → Agent / LLM**.
strings.agent.md.helpFooter: Or use the quick-action chips below.
strings.agent.md.cap.import_curl: • **Import cURL** — paste a curl command → opens a request tab
strings.agent.md.cap.explain_response: • **Explain last response** — summarize status, body, GraphQL errors
strings.agent.md.cap.explain_tests: • **Explain test failures** — walk the last test run
strings.agent.md.cap.workspace_status: • **Workspace status** — Git workspace root + pending mutations
strings.agent.md.cap.graphql_summarize: • **GraphQL summarize** — summarize introspection body on the active tab
strings.agent.md.pasteCurl: Paste a cURL command (or wrap it in a ```bash fence).
strings.agent.md.pasteSse: Paste an SSE document to parse (event/data blocks).
strings.agent.md.capabilityOff: **{capability}** is turned off. Expand agent capabilities in **Settings → Agent / LLM**.
strings.agent.md.parsedCurl:
Parsed **{method}** `{url}`.

Open it as a new request tab?
strings.agent.md.noResponse: No response on the active tab yet. Send a request first.
strings.agent.md.noTests: No test results on the active tab. Run tests after a response.
strings.agent.md.noWorkspace: No Git workspace attached. Set one in **Settings → Data & storage** (collections folder).
strings.agent.md.noWorkspaceHistory: No Git workspace attached — cannot read `.pulse/history.jsonl`.
strings.agent.md.noWorkspaceMemory: No Git workspace attached — cannot recall memory.
strings.agent.md.noWorkspaceForget: No Git workspace attached — cannot forget memory.
strings.agent.md.noWorkspaceMemoryList: No Git workspace attached — memory list is empty.
strings.agent.md.noWorkspaceRemember: No Git workspace attached. Set one in **Settings → Data & storage** before remembering facts.
strings.agent.md.noWorkspaceRag: No Git workspace attached — cannot search RAG index.
strings.agent.md.noWorkspaceRagReindex: No Git workspace attached — cannot rebuild RAG index.
strings.agent.md.noCollection: No active collection with saved requests. Select a collection in the explorer first.
strings.agent.md.runReady: Ready to run **{name}** ({count} requests). Mutating methods may hit your API — confirm to proceed.
strings.agent.md.noGraphqlBody: No response body to summarize. Send an introspection query (or any GraphQL response) first.
strings.agent.md.notGraphql: Body is not a GraphQL introspection payload. Tip: use Docs / GraphQL explorer introspect, then ask again.
strings.agent.md.noSse: No SSE events found in the pasted document.
strings.agent.md.usageRag:
Usage: search history <query>  ·  rag <query>

Filters: `method:POST status:500 env:staging`
strings.agent.md.ragRebuilt:
Rebuilt RAG index with **{count}** documents (history + facts).

_Embedding runtime: hashed n-gram TF-IDF_
strings.agent.md.ragNoHits:
**RAG** for “{query}”

_(no matches — try reindex or a broader query)_
strings.agent.md.ragRuntime: _Embedding runtime: hashed n-gram TF-IDF · filters: `method:POST status:4xx env:staging`_

strings.settings.language.empty: No custom pack loaded — Pulse uses the built-in language.
strings.settings.language.browserHint: In the browser preview, the pack is stored locally in this browser. Use the desktop app to keep a file path and reload edits from disk.
